scope: synthetic-only research gate; not a real-vault quality claim

representative_synthetic_benchmark.requirement: Versioned privacy-safe paraphrase and multilingual cases beyond the two diagnostic probes, with judged citations.

pinned_model_provenance.requirement: A selected model revision, license review, artifact checksum, model-size budget, and provenance record.

offline_acquisition_contract.requirement: An explicit operator-controlled local-cache procedure with no silent network fetch or telemetry.

quality_latency_memory_disk_comparison.requirement: Measured synthetic comparison against lexical retrieval with declared limits for quality, latency, memory, and disk.

opt_in_citation_equivalence.requirement: An explicit opt-in interface that preserves chunk citations, relative-path guarantees, error semantics, and the lexical default.

reopen_rule: Implementation may be proposed only after every prerequisite is READY and a separately approved implementation point is authorized.
